name: tulip
clip: ref/reference_tulip.mp4 (480x640, 15 fps, 20.0 s; clip starts mid-pour); reference frame (targets/tulip.npz) 17.75 s
method: Stream foot = lowest image point of the stream column (or the dark impact hole next to it), picked on native-resolution 3-5x crops with a pixel grid (tiles/footpick.py, pixcrop.py) and mapped to the M frame with video_extract.image_to_cup on the extractor's 15 fps ellipse track (rot -165 deg, (x,y)_M = (x,-y)_T). For t < 3.95 s the track is a near-circular fit whose major axis is arbitrary; positions there use the same centre/size with phi chosen so that +y_M has the same image direction as in the level phase at 4.0 s (tiles/_common.py fixed_ell; see orientation_fix). Wiggle frequency from the spectrum of the column's lateral position in the rectified frame (tiles/wiggle_track.py) and the arc count of the finished base; heights from the visible column length (b/a = sin(elevation) ~0.76-0.84, 25-30 px/cm), flows from the column width at the foot; both +-50 %. Reading the sheared projected grid by eye was off by up to 0.1 D and was not used.

landmarks_M.note: instructor's red dots in the frozen overlay frames (6.53-8.40 s, ellipse of frame 98). The B->D axis points to -107 deg in M (17 deg off -y_M); registration of the late white maps against the reference frame finds no cup rotation (< 3 deg from 10 s on). The dashed white line shown in freeze 1 (3.37-4.30 s) is the wiggle axis: about -12 deg in M, i.e. perpendicular to B->D; the stages use axis -15.

freeze_note: The format is clip time, so each freeze is kept as an explicit stage ("freeze": true) that continues the action at the frozen state; sim time = clip time, but the simulation pours ~2.6 s longer than the barista did. For physical timing use video_targets/tulip/freeze_tools.py (drop_freezes -> stage_scripts/tulip_physical.json, clip_to_phys / phys_to_clip to compare with frames.npz). All six reference clips contain such freeze-frames during the instructor overlays.
orientation_fix: video_extract's ellipse track switches at 3.85 s (inside freeze 1, i.e. on an identical image) from a near-circular fit (a/b = 1.02, phi = 2.43 rad) to the level fit (b/a = 0.82, phi = -2.88 rad). With a ~ b the major axis, hence the T/M frame orientation, is arbitrary: +y_M points to image angle -116 deg before and -57 deg after (59 deg rotation). The level orientation is the one continuous with the final/target frame. frames.npz white maps for t < 3.85 s are therefore rotated by ~60 deg about the disc centre (the extractor was not changed); stage positions below are in the corrected frame.
timing_vs_video_obs: first white is visible at 0.33 s (not 0.9 s); the first pour ends at 5.33 s with a flow cut (not a lift at 6.5 s); the second pour starts at 6.33 s at the far rim and ends at 10.45 s; there is no 'low at the centre with bigger flow' at 10.9-12.3 s (the spout sits dry at the far rim 10.5-11.8 s; the subtitle 将底纹压开 refers to 9.7-10.1 s); the third pour starts at 11.8 s and is a single plain disc (no separate striped element) that becomes the top heart; the cut runs 14.85-16.37 s and ends at the 2nd element's V apex at (-0.13,-0.20): there is no stem to the rim.

first_white_by_eye.note: pour 1: onset before the clip start; pour 2: onset 6.33 s, delay 2.4 s in clip time but ~0.5-0.9 s physically (freeze 2); pour 3: the white disc forms at once under the nearly touching spout

stages.note: pour 1 (base), clip starts mid-pour (true onset < 0 s, first-white delays are lower bounds); cup tilted toward the pitcher until ~2-3 s, tilt-phase geometry +-0.06 D; thick stream (~0.04 D); first white at the foot at 0.33 s, a C opening toward the spout (+y)

看到白色的线条出现后开始摆动 / 纹路形成半圆形后摆动: wiggle in place from 0.85 s (column lateral oscillation 3.0-3.4 Hz, half-amplitude 0.03-0.05 D); arcs ~0.03 D apart, convex toward D (-y), semicircle ~0.4 D by 3.3 s; foot stays at (-0.05+-0.04, 0.05+-0.04) relative to the moving cup

向前移动: forward toward D while wiggling (feet 4.40 (0.00,0.01), 4.60 (-0.05,-0.06), 4.87 (-0.02,-0.13), 5.00 (-0.03,-0.19)); ellipse quality 0 (propagated, level orientation); the arc stack extends toward D

让纹路形成回包: flow cut at low height (stream ~0.01 D wide at 5.2-5.27 s, column only ~1.5 cm long), gone at 5.33 s; the outer arcs then close around the sides into a round base 0.55 D with a brown cleft on the B side
dry: spout carried to the far rim on the B side (lip at (0.08,0.44) at 6.13-6.27 s, touching down at 6.33 s)
第二段再退回B点注入: pour 2 starts at the far rim and lands just inside the B dot (6.40 (0.11,0.33), 6.47 (0.09,0.28)); B dot = (0.05,0.30)

(freeze 6.5-8.43 s clip time shortened to its physical 0.2 s) FREEZE-FRAME with the B/C/D overlay (frames 99-126 = frame 98): ~0.2 s (0.07-0.5 s) of physical time; the base is unchanged across it. Kept as a continuation so that sim time = clip time; shorten to physical_s for physical timing.
pour at B moving in (8.47 (0.07,0.30), 8.60 (0.11,0.21), 8.73 (0.11,0.17)); brown around the foot, the new white (2nd element) appears at 8.73-8.87 s as a C around the foot opening toward +x/+y

摆动的同时往前推: wiggle (visible in the cup-frame kymograph 8.8-9.7 s, ~3.3-3.9 Hz, half-amplitude ~0.02-0.03 D) while pushing toward C (9.00 (0.13,0.18), 9.13 (0.13,0.17), 9.40 (0.10,0.14), 9.53 (0.10,0.13), 9.67 (0.08,0.10)); striped 2nd element, brown arc gap opens between it and the base

将底纹压开 (subtitle at 11 s): big flow held near C (9.80 (0.10,0.11), 9.93 (0.05,0.08), 10.07 (0.04,0.06)); the 2nd element inflates to a ~0.3 D disc, the base is pushed out into a crescent with a 0.05-0.08 D brown gap
flow cut at low height: stream thin from 10.27 s (10.27 (0.01,0.03), 10.40 (0.02,0.06)), gone at 10.53 s; small notch on the B side of the 2nd element
dry: spout carried to the far rim (10.8-11.7 s lip at ~(0.15-0.18, 0.38-0.42), occasional drip), lowered until it almost touches the surface

第三段回到B点: lip almost touching, thick short stream; a plain white disc grows around the foot at once (r ~0.05 D at 12.0 s, 0.12 D at 13.3 s), no wiggle, no visible delay; feet 11.87 (0.18,0.34), 12.27 (0.15,0.35), 12.80 (0.13,0.34), 13.33 (0.14,0.37) (the cup moves; +-0.03 D)

注入一个爱心收尾: spout raised a little (column visible), still a thick stream; the foot travels through the disc toward D (13.47 (0.16,0.34), 13.73 (0.13,0.30), 14.00 (0.10,0.26), 14.27 (0.08,0.22)), opening the heart's notch on the B side and pressing the 2nd element into a V
cut: thin stream (~0.015 D, column ~3 cm long) through the heart's point into the 2nd element (14.93 (-0.01,0.06), 15.07 (-0.02,0.02), 15.20-15.33 (-0.04,-0.01))
cut continues toward D-left (15.60 (-0.03,-0.10), 15.73 (-0.10,-0.17)), dragging the 2nd element into a V (petal apex); the pitcher body sweeps over the left half of the cup from 15.6 s
thin stream lingers at the V apex (16.00 (-0.13,-0.21), 16.13 (-0.13,-0.21), 16.27 (-0.14,-0.18)) and stops at ~16.37 s as the pitcher is lifted away; no stem to the rim
pitcher gone (camera moves for the show-off shot from 16.47 s); reference frame 17.75 s

freezes_removed.evidence: frames 51-64 are copies of frame 50 (3.33 s) with the dashed wiggle-axis line (mean |diff| < 0.15); frame 65 (4.33 s) differs from frame 50 like a 1-2 frame step (6.3 vs 4-7 for adjacent live frames), so no physical time passes

frames 99-126 are copies of frame 98 (6.53 s, B/C/D overlay); the camera has jumped at 8.47 s (cup ~9 px higher, a 7 % smaller), but the rectified base pattern is unchanged between 6.47 and 8.67 s and the rectified frame difference across the freeze equals 5-10 live frames, so at most ~0.5 s of real time is skipped
